quickbooks._note: Accounting system of record. UNVERIFIED endpoint — Intuit's own MCP offering and the community servers move; confirm at install. Fallback: export CSV and load with plugins/fin/scripts/load_csv.py. Read scopes are sufficient unless mutation_mode is approved_apply.

xero._note: Alternative accounting system of record. Xero publishes an official MCP server; verify the endpoint. Use one of quickbooks/xero, not both, unless you are consolidating.

stripe._note: Payments and subscription data — the source for MRR/ARR inputs. Stripe ships an official MCP server. USE A RESTRICTED, READ-ONLY KEY. A full-access Stripe key in an agent is a refund button.

plaid._note: Banking: balances and transactions. This is the authoritative source for cash. UNVERIFIED endpoint.

ramp._note: Corporate card and spend. Swap for Brex/Expensify/Bill.com equivalently. UNVERIFIED endpoint.

gsheets._note: Manual schedules, the budget if it lives in a sheet, and CSV ingestion. Also the fallback path when a system has no API.

warehouse._note: Postgres/Snowflake/BigQuery for product and revenue data that never reaches the GL. READ-ONLY ROLE ONLY.

fred._note: Federal Reserve economic data for rate and macro context. Public, no key on the API itself.

edgar._note: SEC EDGAR for public-company benchmarking. Public data; requires a declared user agent.

_install_note: Every endpoint marked UNVERIFIED must be confirmed or deleted at install. A missing server is not fatal: snapshot_pull returns a fallback instruction and the CSV path still works. What IS fatal is a write-scoped credential — grant read-only everywhere unless you have deliberately enabled approved_apply and understand the blast radius.
